summary: Iteration 7: tested pending registration gating, admin activate/suspend, admin manual per-currency balance edit, admin-only guards, hot-wallet shape, recovery scan + address filter, exchange graceful 400, plus frontend two-panel login + language toggle + /requests testids + Settings Users tab testids + /checkout testids with both countdowns. 13/13 backend tests pass. All critical frontend criteria verified.

minor.issue: When a currencies[] entry omits 'network' the handler raises 500 (TypeError: int(None)) at server.py:883 instead of returning 400 with a clear message. Low prio – frontend always sends network, but should validate the field.

verified_criteria: GET /api/admin/users returns each user with 'status' and 'balances' array
PUT /api/admin/users/{uid}/balance {USDT,500} persists; the user's GET /api/wallet shows USDT=500
GET /api/recovery/scan works for admin and ?address=<x> filters (scanned.evm=0 for unused address, no 500)
POST /api/wallet/exchange with from_network/to_network returns 400 (not 500) when liquidity path unavailable
FRONTEND /login: two-panel layout, data-testids login-email/password/submit/lang present, lang toggle UK↔EN flips 'Увійти' -> 'Sign in'
FRONTEND /requests: invoice-search, invoice-period, payout-search present. invoice-pager/payout-pager not rendered when result set <= 1 page (acceptable conditional UI)

FRONTEND /settings Користувачі tab: user-suspend-<uid>, bal-iso-<uid>, bal-amount-<uid>, bal-save-<uid>, user-status-<uid> all present; user-activate-<uid> absent only because no pending user existed (test cleanup)
FRONTEND /checkout/{id}: checkout-currency, checkout-network, checkout-pay-btn, checkout-expiry all present; rate countdown (01:56) and time-left-to-pay countdown (55:59) both animate
action_items: (minor) In _create_invoice (server.py ~line 883) coerce missing/None 'network' to a 400 with a clear 'network required' message instead of letting int(None) raise 500.
critical_code_review_comments: Pending gating correctly implemented via get_active_user() checking status=='active'.
admin_set_balance uses upsert + records an admin_adjust transaction with delta – good audit trail.
recovery_scan correctly accepts optional ?address and filters addresses pre-scan – no 500 paths observed.
exchange() returns 400 (not 500) when no on-chain route; good.
_create_invoice does not validate currencies[].network – should Pydantic-validate the sub-shape.
